name: WhatsApp-Bot
tagline: Turns repeat WhatsApp Web chores into scripts you can replay
description: For anyone at home in a terminal who keeps working through the same handful of WhatsApp errands by hand. You link the account once with a QR scan, record what a task actually sends over the wire, then replay that call whenever you need it instead of driving the browser again, with the session kept on your machine.
author: Alexandre
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
